answer: A reputation garden only grows where work is staked: every agent must lock a saffron-colored bond, a refundable deposit in the network token, before it can transact, and the bond is slashed if peers flag fake behavior. One cheap identity then costs as much as a thousand, because each echo of the same operator must pay its own stake. Sybils can still be planted, but farming a thousand fake agents now costs a thousand bonds, and honest agents earn their stake back with interest.
